notes.title: October 2019 Update: Spooky Halloween!
notes.notes:
Hey Bombers,

School is back in session (sorry to remind you...) and so is Bomber Barn development!

The Return of the Spooky Core
To get into the Halloween spirit, we've re-added the special spooky version of the Core map:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34194161/6bc91a024c6a7dda33d535479e466040e39fcde7.png

This might look familiar to you if you were at our live events last year. Due to technical reasons, it looks a bit different -- personally, we think it's better now, but let us know which you prefer!

New Hats & Skins
With this latest update, we've added several cosmetic options to differentiate yourself further from other bombers on the battlefield. *cue fashion model runway music*

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34194161/4d2239e23c13f187e33016806d71054be1c1ff18.gif

Do the Wave
Another new visual touch: whenever a bomber is eliminated, a shockwave ripples outward. Ouch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34194161/38512d4f83d3467bd347697ccb4b2d3623e48834.gif

Fixing Bugs on the Keyboard
And lastly, no update would be complete without squashing some bugs. There were some issues when two players were playing on the keyboard -- hopefully now everything's good and final.

That's all we've got, now that September is behind us. Remember to post on the Steam forums, Twitter, or anywhere else to share your feedback on Bomber Barn.

Bombs away!

notes.title: August 2019 Update: Steamworks!
notes.notes:
Hey Bombers,

I hope you've been having a nice summer! It's been quite hot and humid so far in New York, but hopefully some of you are in more comfortable places.

This is basically our biggest structural update before adding new in-game content. In other words, we welcome a few long overdue additions:

Steamworks Integration
Bomber Barn now has support for Steam features! Right now, that means:

 stats
 achievements
 Steam Cloud saves

We're starting with 1 achievement for now - more to come!

Steam Cloud support is used to sync your progress in the game, such as which maps and outfits you've unlocked.

*** Please note that your save file will almost certainly no longer be loaded correctly. ***

The next time you launch Bomber Barn, you'll start from scratch. 

*** To fix this, we've included a top secret cheat code you can enter at the title screen to receive 200 coins. ***

Hopefully this lets you re-unlock everything you had before. Check the end of this post for the code!

Custom Controls
You are no longer forced to use the stock control scheme. If you want to, say, assign Drop Bomb to the Right Bumper on your controller, now you can! Simply go to Controller Setup, join in, and you'll automatically be prompted to set your Drop Bomb and Special Ability buttons.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/dde68562f30414f260b005b6d7867ec29a8ce71f.png


Various Text Enhancements
The Sudden Death countdown is a bit more prominent now:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/05f0831e5ea11a009921cb5235dbe280051ff65b.gif

The "chapter title" on the bottom-left corner of the Tutorial used to show up incorrectly on Windows, which should be fixed now. Also, the "Exit Tutorial" text prompt animates slightly as a visual hint when it's over.


Added Settings
You can now set some basic graphics settings in the game, like Quality Level and Fullscreen Mode.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/e2968edecfd1ff5f599fe8eb0f9461cf3d117f94.png


Added Credits
Of course, we always give credit where credit is due. The Main Menu now has a Credits section where you can find out all about the awesome people who helped make Bomber Barn possible!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/af51dc5084e1ec4d15326028e06b206f38e21ae2.png


Thanks for reading this far into the update! Here's the secret cheat code below. Be sure to enter it carefully; you'll hear a coin sound if it works.

← ← → → ← →


As usual, let us know if you run into any strange issues or problems with this version!

Bombs away!

notes.title: May 2019 Update: Pesky Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey Bombers,

We're just about done unwinding after Playcrafting's wonderful Spring Play event in New York City this past weekend, where many, many gamers came together to support local developers!

By our count, over the 4-hour afternoon, we completed about 40 full matches of Bomber Barn. During that time, of course, we also encountered some nasty bugs, which are fixed in this latest update.

Also, several dedicated folks signed up to be special Early Access supporters, which makes us feel warm and fuzzy ːsteamhappyː

So let's cut to the change log, shall we?

4-Player Games Not Starting
There was a strange bug that in many cases prevented the match from starting when four players were all ready. We've now fixed it so full parties can always game!

Hats and Skins Disappearing In-Game
We noticed a lot of folks opting to put on the blue party hat, or take on the black Quick Cat skin. But once the match started, they reverted to the default appearance. Apparently this was an issue mostly on the Mac, but we've fixed it across the board now. Bomb in style!

Fixed UI Scaling on 16:10 Resolutions
This came up during testing on our MacBook, but now everything should look right.

Added Match Record Archive
All completed matches are now saved in a local file (separate than the save file used to track unlocks). There's no way to display any meaningful information from them yet, but it will come in handy down the road for stats, achievements, and other goodies.

Bomber Barn Discord
Stay tuned for more details on our budding community...

Bombs away!

notes.title: April 2019 Update: Sudden Death and Feline Finesse
notes.notes:
Hey Bombers,

Sorry for the radio silence over the past month! Rest assured, we're finally back in action with some new enhancements to Bomber Barn...

Sudden Death
Draws are so boring! By popular demand, we've added a sudden death that kicks in when the round timer expires.

During sudden death, your bomber will begin to automatically drop bombs. As more time passes, you drop them faster and faster, leaving a deadly trail of flames close behind!

Special thanks to riku.petteri for the inspiration ːsteamhappyː

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/2aa7a665bc9118a049ef10be1ef4851da5a55cc6.png

Feline Finesse
We've buffed the Quick Cat, with a new Passive Ability called Feline Finesse. In addition to the usual (faster starting movement), you can now always pass through your own bombs!

This opens up your mobility options a lot and should be a significant buff, especially when playing with certain mix-ins that make everyone speedy to begin with.

Special thanks to lcd_screen for this suggestion ːsteamhappyː

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/f7f7bf2c1cb41d8f39a8bdaf7556238268825baf.gif

Elimination Indicators
When playing in Elimination mode, it was sometimes unclear who got credit for a certain elimination (or if you died to your own bomb).

Now, whenever someone scores an elimination, a "+1" icon will pop up for a few moments in their corner portrait, indicating a point.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/c01864ce7144379b36b859320e9cbbae6af79ddb.gif

Keyboard Controls Modal
On the Title Screen, if no controllers are plugged in, some brief intro text will appear, showing the keyboard controls for P1 and P2. This way, it's up front, without requiring players to look up readmes, etc.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/f910e0027d3d6f5d6bb01f90f033b82af80a5815.png

Bug Fixes & Optimizations

 Fixed bug that did not correctly register bots as players in the match (thanks, MILKMAN and Dexter Monster!)
 Slightly optimized the clouds coming out of Dojo Donkey's kicks


Bomber Barn LIVE in New York
By the way, if you're in the New York City area, come check out Bomber Barn at the Playcrafting Spring Expo on May 18, 2019. It's free and there'll be lots of pizza and fun games to go around. And of course, a sneak peek into what's next for Bomber Barn!

Bombs away!

notes.title: February 2019 Update: Rematches and Cosmetics
notes.notes:
Hey Bombers,

Our first ever Bomber Barn update is out now! Here's an overview of the changes:

Rematch
Whenever a match is over, you now have the option of starting another one right away (same Bombers, same map, same mix-ins). Great for getting revenge after a close game ːsteammockingː

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/29b19fc41b61fe607ef8f380eb322871987ca8a3.png

Toggle Music/Sound
In the pause menu, you can now turn music/sound off.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/3d1e4fee5b00e6c9330f1764f4ea43ce17adad21.png

Launch Issues
We heard from some of you that you couldn't even get Bomber Barn running, which is tragic! This update should get it working now :)

Cosmetics (Finally!)
All Bombers can now put on a light-blue party hat! In addition, Quick Cat has the first skin option available, allowing you to sneak even harder in the shadows now ːsteamhappyː

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/82efbc04911713c202de13f07afdc89496bd766b.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194161/b2bc10bb679e0a0dd548f4b2a3763def4a5560fd.png

That's all for today, folks -- but don't worry, we've got plenty more coming soon, like a Sudden Death mechanic and more content.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

Bombs away!
